title: C-O7b: `orchestrator handover` — write the restart checkpoint into plan.md from bus state so a Planner can resume on another account with one command
spec: Why: when the Planner session dies at a subscription limit, the next session on the other account resumes from .orchestrator/plan.md and the bus; today the checkpoint is only as fresh as the Planner's last manual write. Implement orchestrator/handover.py write(reason: str) -> Path: under the bus lock, replace (or append when absent) a section `## Auto-handover <ISO timestamp, Europe/Zurich> — <reason>` at the end of plan.md containing: open goals (parentless triage tasks not done) with title; per goal the child tasks grouped by status (queued with depends_on, running with executor and started time, held with hold_reason and resume_hint keys, done-not-merged, merged with sha); the worktrees that exist under wt/; the last 5 events from bus.events; and the sentence "Resume: skill resume; re-spawn held spec reviews; dispatch ready execute tasks by hand while Codex cools." Keep the section under 120 lines by truncating lists with "… and N more". cli.py: `handover [--reason TEXT]` (default reason "manual"). Idempotent: a second call replaces the section, it never duplicates it, and the rest of plan.md is byte-identical. Also: daemon.tick() calls handover.write("daemon tick") at most once every 15 minutes (a timestamp in pool_state), so the checkpoint is never older than that even when the Planner is gone. Tests in tests/test_handover.py with the harness fixtures: section content per status group, truncation, idempotent replace preserving the rest of the file, daemon throttle (two ticks within 15 min write once). README.md: two lines under Run it.
acceptance: tests/test_handover.py: writes_section_with_status_groups, truncates_long_lists, replaces_section_idempotently_and_preserves_rest, daemon_throttles_to_15_min; all green
`uv run orchestrator handover --reason test` appends exactly one Auto-handover section to .orchestrator/plan.md in a scratch root and a second run leaves one section
`uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests` green; no new dependency
